info.title: Daftar API
info.description:
REST API for **دفتر (Daftar)** grocery management, served by Next.js at `/api/v1`.

### Authentication
Cookie session (`Daftar.Session`, HttpOnly). To call the API from this page:

1. **`GET /api/v1/auth/csrf`** → returns `{ "token" }` and sets the `Daftar.Csrf` cookie.
2. Sign in with **`POST /api/v1/auth/admin-login`** (platform admin: email + password) or **`POST /auth/otp`** then **`POST /auth/verify`** (shop users: phone + SMS code). Send the token in the `X-CSRF-TOKEN` header.
3. **Request `/auth/csrf` again after signing in** — the token is bound to the signed-in user.
4. Every `POST`/`PATCH` needs `X-CSRF-TOKEN`. Shop and subscription commands also need a unique **`Idempotency-Key`** (8–128 chars); repeating a key returns the stored response instead of running the command twice.

### Conventions
- Money is integer **cents** (`…Cents`, ILS). Quantities are decimals (up to 3 places, only for unit `كغم`).
- Dates are `yyyy-mm-dd` in the Asia/Hebron business day; timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC.
- Errors are RFC 9457 problem details: `{ "title", "status" }` with an Arabic `title`.
- Lists return `{ items, page, pageSize, total }` (`pageSize` ≤ 100).
- Cashier responses omit cost fields (`null`).

csrf.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
csrf.description: Token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf (re-fetch after signing in).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique per command (8–128 chars), e.g. a UUID. Reuse it only to safely retry the same request.
